decisions.decision: Q4 always-resident base (0.909 GiB); Q8 hot-swap individual tensors into headroom. Never both full models simultaneously (2.6 GiB > 2.0 GiB wall). Tensor-aligned manifests required.

DML MHA1+PastSequenceLengths is UNAVAILABLE on HD 4600 (create=0x80070057 despite feature level 0x6400). Use base MHA + validity mask. Fixed-capacity feedback path is BLOCKED because base MHA doesn't compact.
134 fixed bindings built once per session + 12 dynamic MHA bindings per token = 1.33x total speedup (mean/token 120.5->94.7ms). MHA bindings (#004-B) deferred — trajectory preserved.

native/ggml-xcfe is a real registering backend with CPU-delegated buffers + DML GEMM via dml_gemm.dll. Verified: XCFE registered, MUL_MAT matches CPU, DirectML GEMM at 2.7e-07. It is NOT a full KHANARY semantic backend yet — no glyph routing, no K'UHUL phase law.

C (field-only @flux on frozen model): FAIL — mechanism falsified. C2-proxy (sign(PMI) @flux): PASS +1.026 nats over frequency baseline, proxy branch FROZEN. C2b (graded PMI, direction+bounded strength): PASS +0.314 over C2, proxy branch FROZEN. C2-real: BLOCKED (execution-valid, learning-incomplete).
